{{Quote|And a pot of mei-mei tea, if you have it, please, Nikollane?|Jennir orders mei-mei tea|<ref name="DT16" />}}
'''Mei-mei tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] that was served at [[Ember's Fire]], a [[Brothel/Legends|brothel]] located in the [[Noua]] archipelago on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] ordered [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and a pot of mei-mei tea from the [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] [[Nikollane]] while staying at Ember's in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Nikollane then informed Jennir that her [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Dado]], had run off to join a [[Musori's gang|gang]] of [[Slavery/Legends|enslavers]], so the ex-Jedi left before his tea was made to try and stop Dado.<ref name="DT16" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mei-mei tea was mentioned in the [[Dark Times 16|sixteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]''. The issue was written by [[Randy Stradley|Mick Harrison]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DT16" /> on [[April 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-930/Star-Wars-Dark-Times-16----Blue-Harvest-part-4|text=Star Wars: Dark Times 16 -- Blue Harvest part 4}}</ref>
